description:
A well-presented and improved 3-bedroom, 1-reception rooms, period terraced house boasting stylish interiors and well-maintained features and attic storage. Conveniently located with easy access to amenities and transport links. Ideal for first-time buyers or investors looking for a characterful property in a sought-after location. The property has been rented out as a four bedroom dwelling and could be again with the necessarry permissions. Viewing highly recommended.

Introducing this charming period terraced house, boasting two bedrooms and two reception rooms. This stylish property has been meticulously maintained, offering a perfect blend of traditional features and modern conveniences. The spacious living room is ideal for relaxing or entertaining guests, while the well-appointed kitchen is a chef's delight with ample storage and worktop space. Upstairs, the two bedrooms provide comfortable accommodation, with the master bedroom benefiting from generous built-in wardrobes. Outside situated in a sought-after location, this property is within easy reach of local amenities, schools, and transport links. Don't miss the opportunity to make this lovely house your new home.
